title: One-step correspondence of the counting host
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be finite Boolean words, let $c$ be a configuration of a source machine with empty input, and let $a$ be one of its actions. Form the counting-host configuration whose native input-head position is the saturated position for $|s|+|c.output|$, whose work tapes store $s$ and the source work tapes, and whose state records whether $|w|<|s|+|c.output|$. Applying the transformed action to this configuration, using the symbol it scans on its native input, gives exactly the counting-host configuration associated with the source configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $c$.
replaced:
Applying the transformed action to the counting-host embedding of a source
configuration yields exactly the counting-host embedding of the source
configuration after the original action: one native input cell is consumed
per source emission, the candidate is preserved, and all source-bank writes
and moves are reproduced.
